content.subject: Happy birthday! A free Kunafa is waiting
content.headline: Something sweet is on us
content.body: Thank you for being part of the Ember & Spice Grill family. Pop in this week and we will finish your meal with a little treat. Please ask our staff about allergens before you order.

offer.description: Free Kunafa with any main in your birthday week
offer.conditions: One free Kunafa per customer with any main, during your birthday week. This email goes only to customers whose birthday falls between Monday 12 October and Sunday 18 October, so the offer ends on Sunday 18 October.

output.expected_outcome: First campaign of this kind, no baseline yet.

checks.reason: Warm, short, upbeat and says thank you, in line with the profile tone notes. No emojis, which is allowed.
Names the restaurant and its Kunafa birthday offer.
Plain UK English, no jargon.
No previous outputs to repeat.
No em-dashes or emojis in the draft. words_to_avoid is empty.
The offer, allergen line, Kunafa and audience size all trace to resolved sources.
The £5.95 value matches the Kunafa menu price. The audience of 3 matches can_be_emailed.
Monday 12 October to Sunday 18 October is correct and consistent with the 7-day birthday segment. The send date is today.
Kunafa and the restaurant name match the profile exactly.
No causal claims. expected_outcome honestly says there is no baseline.
The allergen line matches the profile statement word for word. No other food claims.
Clear what, when and conditions. free_item is an approved offer type. No fake urgency.
The segment is birthdays only. It is not based on religion, ethnicity or other personal traits.
Nothing is offered in exchange for a review.
No personal details beyond the first name merge from the template.
No financial, legal or staffing advice.
Standard email. The footer has unsubscribe and data links via the template.

Subject is about 40 characters, headline is 5 words and body is about 35 words. The offer is on the current menu and within the cap. The email-only channel is respected. No em-dashes. No claims beyond the profile.
Offer email template with restaurant header, brand-style colours and button.
The photo library is empty, so the no-photo template version is correctly used.
Everything fits and reads fine on mobile. The offer box is a little long and repeats itself.
No empty slots. [First name] is a template merge field filled in per customer. The button is present.
